prerequisite: evidence/wrench-recovery-v3/acceptance.json must be accepted before preparing or running this stage
purpose: Test explicit reuse of source-backed successful native-episode experience by a fresh actor. This is a two-case development pilot, not a statistical estimate or causal learning evaluation.
case_selection: Repeated development seed5, the same geometry and placement as the successful source. It is not a new held-out context. No source, prompt, skill or case changes after freezing this pair.
actor: Fresh native Codex sub-agent per case, fork none, same inherited model settings without overrides. Exact served model and sampling variation are not controlled/exposed.
contrast: Only the additional native-episode experience record differs. Both receive the nominal engineering guidance, state/contact/geometry feedback, fresh two-view images and identical control APIs, skill access and budgets.
physical_acceptance: All independent lift/turn/withdraw gates, raw reply/executed-action bindings, exact saved physical replay, 500Hz cadence, accepted finish, no runtime error, individual normal<=25N, global penetration<=2mm and zero direct robot-nut contact. A new correction event is optional in this stage.
local_skill_acceptance: Exact frozen observation-only policy replay, initial accepted-command ownership, online selection binding and separate online/local counts. Same limits and resources in both cases.
memory_acceptance: The fresh memory case physically succeeds; additional source record is bound to metadata and every request; at least one completed online alignment action explicitly cites a valid fixed-head-target lesson and its intended head target matches the lesson expressed in the current measured nut frame. Files support declared adoption consistency, not causal access to internal reasoning.
comparison_reporting: Report both planned cases, including failure or timeout, all declared inputs, physical gates, online/local counts, total robot commands, simulation time and wall time. No token/API-call claims. A null or negative efficiency comparison remains a valid result; memory-use demonstration requires a successful memory case, not baseline failure.
source_memory: experiences/wrench-native-v1.json; immutable source-backed episode plus derived conditional lessons, no weight fitting or hidden new optimization
failed_source_trials: Native001 and002 remain failed development attempts; successful native003 includes a disclosed corrected retrospective audit for one exact operation label. No older result is relabeled as success.
root_role: Launch and monitor only; no robot-action choices, writes, replacements or strategic actor messages during either episode.
retention: Preserve every case, raw replies/intents, local skill states, source/experience hashes, 500Hz physics, continuous videos, audits and failures under the existing2GB new-evidence ceiling.
external_services: No further DeepSeek calls, external model calls or remote-workstation jobs.
next_gate: Do not start changed-placement tests until successful fresh-agent reuse and the planned comparison report are accepted. New wrench geometry remains after placement.
